headline: Energy storage in Europe keeps growing fast, with large financed projects in Finland and Germany. Europe still depends on Chinese cells (90% of extra-EU lithium-ion imports), and hydrogen is behind plan.

signals.title: EIC Pathfinder Open 2027 opens
signals.detail: Opens 2026-11-25, with EUR 166 million for about 45 grants. Stage 1 deadline is 2027-02-25. No other major new news was found for 17-25 November.

signals.title: Elements Green gets TenneT grid connection commitment for 1.6 GWh BESS
signals.detail: 400 MW / 1.6 GWh Stadorf project in Germany. The company plans 3.2 GW in Germany by 2027. This is another sign that 4-hour systems are being financed.

signals.title: Kemijärvi pumped-storage plants: few jobs after construction
signals.detail: Four plants are planned, the first in Finland. A Ramboll study expects about EUR 15 million of local spending in construction and about 6.3 person-years a year in operation.

signals.title: ACER 2026 hydrogen market monitoring report
signals.detail: Reportedly says electrolytic hydrogen is growing but not fast enough and that storage deployment is limited. Draft TYNDP 2026 lists 73 hydrogen storage projects of about 1 million t. From a search summary; the PDF could not be read.

signals.title: Gore Street's EU battery fund reaches 550 MWh
signals.detail: Second close of the EU fund. Next deals are planned in Spain and Romania.

signals.title: EU Grids Package trilogues are under way
signals.detail: The Council's Coreper I agenda for 11 and 13 November (ST 15420/26 REV 2) lists a Presidency debriefing on the outcome of a TEN-E trilogue and preparation for a permitting-directive trilogue. Commentary targets a deal in late 2026 or early 2027. This rests on a search summary of the agenda; the PDF could not be read.

signals.title: Industry-led Finnish battery strategy advises against mass cell production
signals.detail: The updated national battery strategy, led by Finnish Battery Industries and presented at Kokkola Material Week, says Finland should not pursue high-volume cell manufacturing. It prioritises the cathode-materials chain, security of supply, and high-value systems and digital services (mobile work machines, microbatteries, smart energy storage), and calls for turning R&D into export products. The article gives no numeric targets.

signals.title: EIC Work Programme 2027 reported adopted, with an energy materials Pathfinder Challenge
signals.detail: A consultancy summary updated on 2026-11-11 says the programme was adopted as Decision C(2026)7629. Accelerator cut-offs are 2027-01-20, 2027-03-17, 2027-09-01 and 2027-11-04. EIC Transition closes 2027-09-14 (some sources say 2027-09-16). A Pathfinder Challenge on advanced materials for electricity generation, storage and transmission closes 2027-09-29. The adoption date itself was not found, and the dates are not checked against the Commission text.

signals.title: EIC 2027 calls open on the Funding and Tenders portal
signals.detail: EIC Accelerator 2027 short proposals opened on 2026-11-10 (final portal deadline 2027-12-16; the budget is not published on the portal). EIC STEP Scale Up opens 2026-11-18. Pathfinder Open (EUR 166 million, about 45 grants of EUR 1-5 million) opens 2026-11-25, with stage 1 due 2027-02-25 and stage 2 on 2027-09-16.

signals.title: Vensum Power raises EUR 9 million Series A
signals.detail: Helsinki power-conversion company, listed in the Aalto Startup Center portfolio. Whether it is formally an Aalto spin-off is not confirmed.

signals.title: Return secures EUR 835 million portfolio financing for German BESS
signals.detail: Pooled project financing for large-scale batteries. This is a sign of maturing finance and rising demand for optimisation software.

signals.title: Industry groups say EU battery regulation is on the wrong path
signals.detail: Battery, storage and e-mobility groups criticised the EU approach to battery regulation. Only a search summary was seen, and the specific demands were not read. Due diligence obligations are already postponed to 2027-08-18, and the Omnibus IV proposal would raise the turnover threshold from EUR 40 million to EUR 150 million.

signals.title: Industry groups say the EU is taking the wrong approach to battery regulation
signals.detail: Reported in a search summary only. The text of the statement was not found. Background: battery due diligence obligations are postponed to 2027-08-18, and Omnibus IV would narrow their scope. Industry wants alignment with CSDDD and CSRD.

signals.title: Flower reported to start trading a 30 MW / 30 MWh battery at Kaunola, Finland
signals.detail: Renewables Now reports that the Swedish optimiser Flower has begun full-scale operations in Finland with this battery in the electricity and ancillary service markets. The page could not be opened in this run, so the details and date come from the search summary only.

signals.title: CIP's 500 MW / 2-hour Coalburn 1 BESS enters commercial operation (UK)
signals.detail: Reported by Energy-Storage.News in a search summary; the article was not opened. It is one of the largest operating BESS in Europe, alongside BW ESS Hams Hall (350 MW / 1,240 MWh).

signals.title: Italy authorises 3.7 GW of battery storage projects in October
signals.detail: ESS News reports 3.7 GW authorised in October after 3.2 GW in September, nearly 7 GW in two months. Figures are from the search summary; the article was not opened.

signals.title: Fingrid to raise main grid fees 4% and build the 400 kV Forest Line 2
signals.detail: Fingrid's January to September review says main grid service fees rise by four per cent from 2027-01-01, and that it decided to invest in the roughly 350 km Vaala to Jämsä line, due in 2030. These points come from the search summary of the release; the release page itself could not be opened.

signals.title: Delta Capacity closes financing for two Finnish batteries (250 MW/600 MWh)
signals.detail: Includes the 125 MW/300 MWh AKKU One in Lapinlahti. Shows that lenders are willing to finance merchant-exposed storage in Finland.

signals.title: Foresight acquires the 100 MW/400 MWh Nivala BESS project
signals.detail: Fully permitted, ready-to-build project in North Ostrobothnia, acquired by Foresight Energy Infrastructure Partners II.

signals.title: Fingrid requires grid-forming support for new wind and solar in weak grids
signals.detail: Batteries sized at ±10%, ±20% or ±30% of plant capacity, depending on the area's short-circuit ratio (ESCR), can meet the requirement. This creates demand for grid-forming battery and control technology.

signals.title: Nala Renewables starts construction on 125 MW / 250 MWh Vuolijoki BESS
signals.detail: Notice to proceed issued for one of the largest BESS projects in Finland to start construction; it follows Nala's purchase of ready-to-build projects from Finnish developers such as Fu-Gen.

signals.title: Fu-Gen sells 100 MW Kärppiö BESS to Nala Renewables
signals.detail: Ready-to-build standalone project in Teuva, sold under a framework agreement between the two companies.

signals.title: Delta Capacity starts 125 MW / 300 MWh Kärppiö BESS with Sungrow
signals.detail: Second Delta project under construction after AKKU One in Lapinlahti. Commissioning is planned for Q4 2027.

signals.title: EUPD Research forecasts European storage at 57 GWh in 2026
signals.detail: Forecast of +78% YoY. It is higher than SolarPower Europe's forecast of more than 50 GWh.

companies.what: Sand batteries for district heating. The Loviisa unit is operating, and a 250 MWh unit for Lahti is due in summer 2027.

companies.name: Merus Power
companies.what: Grid-forming BESS maker. A 30 MW / 80 MWh project in Rovaniemi is due by end of 2026.

companies.name: Fingrid
companies.what: Finnish TSO. Sets the grid-forming requirement and is building Forest Line 2.

companies.name: Delta Capacity
companies.what: Battery developer. It has financed 250 MW / 600 MWh and is building Kärppiö, and AKKU One has a Centrica tolling deal.

companies.name: Halide Energy
companies.what: Aalto spin-off developing copper flow batteries, from the CuBER project.

companies.name: Vensum Power
companies.what: Software-defined power conversion. EUR 9 million Series A in November 2026, and it is in the Aalto Startup Center portfolio.

companies.name: Automous Oy
companies.what: Storage optimisation SaaS from the Aalto ecosystem, with a EUR 575,000 pre-seed round.

companies.name: Elcogen
companies.what: Solid oxide cells for electrolysis and fuel cells, Vantaa.

companies.name: Nala Renewables
companies.what: Infrastructure investor. It bought Fu-Gen's 100 MW Teuva project and is building Vuolijoki (125 MW / 250 MWh).

companies.name: Statkraft
companies.what: Optimises OX2's two Finnish batteries (110 MW / 220 MWh and 125 MW / 250 MWh) for seven years from 2028.

companies.what: Developer of a 400 MW / 1.6 GWh BESS with a TenneT connection commitment.

companies.what: Battery materials. Second pCAM line in Kokkola, Finland, and a new plant planned.
